name: build_proposal_two_way_bike_lane
notes: apply_osm_parking(louellen_st_west, right): 4.9 ft hatched - too narrow for a stall
apply_osm_parking(louellen_st_west, left): 8 ft stalls + 1.6 ft hatched to the kerb - no restriction tagged

AddTwoWayBikeLane(w_broad_st_northeast, left): 8 ft two-way lane, 3 ft buffer. Spends 11.82 ft of this leg's 32.10 ft between kerbs, leaving two 10.14 ft travel lanes with the centreline shifted 7.12 ft toward the right kerb - under the 11 ft target by 0.86 ft, which is this leg's width rather than a choice, so the travel way is split equally. The NJDOT alignment does not move; every station and crossing frame is measured from it as before. NOTE: NJDOT's Bicycle Compatible Roadways and Bikeways (1996) calls a two-way bike lane on one side of the roadway 'unacceptable'; that guidance predates separated bikeways and MUTCD 11th ed. 9E.06 now marks them, but the departure has to be argued, not assumed - see STANDARDS.md 4.

AddBikeLaneBollards(w_broad_st_northeast, left): flex-post delineators at 8 ft in the 3 ft buffer between the travel lane and the bike lane - the traffic side, which is the side that needs protecting.

AddTwoWayBikeLane(w_broad_st_southwest, right): 10 ft two-way lane, 3 ft buffer. Spends 13.82 ft of this leg's 42.82 ft between kerbs, leaving two 11.00 ft travel lanes with the centreline shifted 4.25 ft toward the left kerb, and 7.00 ft spare against that kerb. The NJDOT alignment does not move; every station and crossing frame is measured from it as before. NOTE: NJDOT's Bicycle Compatible Roadways and Bikeways (1996) calls a two-way bike lane on one side of the roadway 'unacceptable'; that guidance predates separated bikeways and MUTCD 11th ed. 9E.06 now marks them, but the departure has to be argued, not assumed - see STANDARDS.md 4.

AddBikeLaneBollards(w_broad_st_southwest, right): flex-post delineators at 8 ft in the 3 ft buffer between the travel lane and the bike lane - the traffic side, which is the side that needs protecting.

ExtendBikeLaneThroughJunction(w_broad_st_northeast left -> w_broad_st_southwest right): the bike lane's green carried across the junction as a dotted lane extension - MUTCD 11th ed. 9E.03(07) Standard (extensions through intersections shall be dotted) and 9E.06(15) Guidance (extension markings should cross intersections AND driveways for a buffer-separated lane); NACTO Urban Bikeway Design Guide, bidirectional lanes continue through intersections as a crossbike.
